identification: 1930s-style Art Deco American slip-shade chandelier: cast gilt/bronze-finish metal body and chain with a stepped fan (skyscraper) motif, four frosted pale-green glass slip shades plus a small centre/bottom shade (5 light), W-45 cm. Could be original 1930s or a modern reproduction, and condition (chips, rewiring) can't be judged. Photos show it hung in a shed.

viewing_check: Estimate 50-90, no current bid shown. Photos show 5 intact frosted green slip shades and gilt cast frame, hung in a shed; no maker mark seen. Check on the day: chips/cracks/flea-bites on each shade (the usual loss), whether all shades match (5 lights, 4 side plus bottom), whether the frame is cast metal (original) or a reproduction, wiring (needs rewiring, safety), canopy and chain present, true width 45cm. Eligible sold prices Dec 2023 to Oct 2026 for complete 5 shade fixtures A$340-983, median about A$425, no clear trend (latest A$405 Oct 2026). Green frosted is less common than the typical amber/peach/orange.
